track.name: Ashiyan
track.caption: press play – this one always reminds me of you and our long drives.

notes.quote: you've covered for me, fought for me, and shown up for me more times than i can count. i noticed every single one.
no one roasts me like you. no one cheers me up like you either. i'd pick our brand of nonsense any day.
through every high and low, you've been my constant anchor. thank you for simply being you—my absolute favorite human.

memories.caption: hanging out with you two in college made me realize i actually have friends. i am so grateful to have you both in my life! ❤️
doing kalesh with you and still being friends with you and chilling out like nothing happened. ❤️
you are the friend i can run and cry to for every little inconvenience. thank you for listening to all my nonsense and being there for me in the worst and the best. ❤️

paragraphs: I'm not great at saying soft stuff, so I built this little page instead. Hanging out with you two in college made me realize what actual friendship feels like, and I am so incredibly grateful to have you both in my life. ❤️

Whether we are doing kalesh and chilling out the next minute like nothing happened, or I am running to you to cry about every little inconvenience, you've always been there. Thank you for listening to my constant nonsense, and for being in my corner through the worst and the best of times.

Even if we stop talking someday in the future, I just want you guys to know that you will always remain special to me. I will remember and cherish every single moment and all the time we have spent together in this college.
